Since the instruction was that "docstrings are the source of truth," this violates that principle. Either:
1. Revert DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH to 40 (per docstring) and flag that test_default_length_for_long_titles contradicts the docstring, or
2. Change DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH to 50 AND update the docstring to say "which is 50"

The apostrophe handling (Change 2) and word-boundary truncation logic (Change 3) are both correct implementations of the docstring algorithm and should be kept.
